items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I don't know how Sonny Greer got his knowledge, but he just played himself.

ctx.x: I didn't hang out with drummers. I was out there over the bars or all that. The other drummers were out over the bars too. I don't know how Sonny Greer got his knowledge, but he just played himself.
How did -- what did you think of Sonny Greer's playing?

items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Crawford's wife was one of the dancers, too.

ctx.x: My wife couldn't see me with a telescope and she was one of the lead dancers. That's right.
Jimmy Crawford's wife was one of the dancers, too.
